description: This file defines an abstract class 'Formatter' used for formatting SCSS code, including methods for handling blocks, properties, and source maps within the SCSSPHP project.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: An abstract base class for formatting SCSS code, managing indentation, property formatting, block output, and source map integration.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns indentation whitespace string, default empty.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Formats a property assignment with name and value.

methods.name: customProperty
methods.description: Formats a custom property assignment, preserving spaces in value.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Outputs a non-empty block, handling indentation and nested blocks.

methods.name: testEmptyChildren
methods.description: Tests and cleans empty child blocks.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats an OutputBlock into a string, optionally with source map.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs a string, handling source map updates and semi-colon stripping.
